line: Glock 23s and .223s, LeBron and Jordan same team
vault_lines: Glock 23s and .223s, LeBron and Jordan same team
meaning:
LeBron James and Michael Jordan are two of the greatest basketball players of all time. Both wore the number 23 in their respective careers, meaning that if a team had both of them that team would have two “23”’s. In the NBA, you can’t have two players on the same team with the same number, so Bron would probably switch to the number 6, which he wore with the Miami Heat.

.223 is a type of ammo, sometimes known as 5.56.
